#!/bin/bash

# Check if correct number of arguments provided
if [ $# -ne 2 ]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 <input_date> <format_string>"
    exit 1
fi

input_date="$1"
format_string="$2"

# Extract year, month, day from input date (handle various separators)
year=$(echo "$input_date" | sed 's/[^0-9]*\([0-9]\{4\}\)[^0-9].*/\1/')
month=$(echo "$input_date" | sed 's/[^0-9]*[0-9]\{4\}[^0-9]*\([0-9]\{1,2\}\)[^0-9].*/\1/')
day=$(echo "$input_date" | sed 's/.*[^0-9]\([0-9]\{1,2\}\)$/\1/')

# Zero-pad month and day to 2 digits
month=$(printf "%02d" "$month")
day=$(printf "%02d" "$day")

# Replace format tokens with actual values
result="$format_string"
result=$(echo "$result" | sed "s/%Y/$year/g")
result=$(echo "$result" | sed "s/%m/$month/g")
result=$(echo "$result" | sed "s/%d/$day/g")

echo "$result"
EOF
